01_weather_inputs.title: Load and check the weather inputs

02_window_search.title: Recalculate the sliding-window search
02_window_search.note: Fits the eligible linear-window search from the daily data, then runs 500 new randomised searches. Base R; no individual bird records are needed.

03_window_results.title: Read and check the saved window results
03_window_results.note: Reads the data-only RDS and recalculates selection and the empirical probability from its 500 saved searches.

04_environment_model.title: Fit spring-temperature location and scale
04_environment_model.note: Fits the Gaussian mean and log-SD likelihood to 46 annual temperatures. Coefficients for time are per decade; this is not a reproductive model.

05_predictor_checks.title: Check temperature-year correlations and inspect VIF
05_predictor_checks.note: Recalculates annual correlations. Displays the saved brood-level VIFs; recalculating those VIFs requires the individual analysis records.

06_clutch_output.title: Read the clutch model and calculate its mean
06_clutch_output.note: Reads fitted coefficients and recalculates reference means. It does not refit the mixed model; fitting code is shown below.

07_fledging_output.title: Read the fledging model and calculate expected success
07_fledging_output.note: Reads fitted coefficients and recalculates reference means. It does not refit the mixed model; fitting code is shown below.

08_within_between_output.title: Recalculate within-between summaries
08_within_between_output.note: Uses real aggregate model outputs. A lower clutch SD means greater consistency; a higher fledging component precision means greater consistency.

09_joint_year_output.title: Read year effects from both temperature models
09_joint_year_output.note: Both models include continuous year and thermal predictors together. These are temperature-adjusted year associations, not year-only trends.

10_draw_joint_year.title: Draw the calendar-year figure
10_draw_joint_year.note: Draws both temperature formulations from saved prediction tables. Modify the code and rerun to change the figure.

11_draw_within_between.title: Draw within-between predictions
11_draw_within_between.note: Draws real fitted curves and their saved 95% confidence intervals. No model fitting is repeated.

12_draw_windows.title: Draw window-search diagnostics
12_draw_windows.note: Draws the saved candidate surface and null distribution; the search itself runs in the sliding-window chapter.

13_draw_temporal_trends.title: Draw calendar-year trends from saved predictions
13_draw_temporal_trends.note: Uses saved model predictions and draws a new figure in your browser. No model is refitted.
